prompt: Enable tracing to LangSmith for the staging environment of shop/, into the LangSmith project `shop-staging`, metadata only. The API key is in our password manager; I'll put it into .env.staging myself. Don't deploy.

checks.expr: get(data, 'tracing.enabled') is True and get(data, 'tracing.langsmith.project') == 'shop-staging' and get(data, 'tracing.capture', 'metadata') == 'metadata'
checks.why: chart values tracing.{enabled,capture,langsmith.project} in the staging values file

reference: Add `tracing: {enabled: true, capture: metadata, langsmith: {project: shop-staging}}` to deployment/helm/shop/values-staging.yaml only; LANGSMITH_API_KEY is already in secrets.keys, so the user puts it in .env.staging and runs `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env staging`, then deploys per the CD mode.
